description:
LANDED 296820f6e (merged to wt/kdt13-boundaries 2026-08-31; built and
verified in the round that discovered fz-kdt.93, re-applied and re-proven
after fz-kdt.93 landed).

THE FIX: EntryReachability::new sorts+dedups its clause list by body_id
(planner-enforced source order, dispatch_matrix/pattern.rs
NonMonotonicBodyId), replacing analyze_activation's first-occurrence
row-arrival dedupe (deleted same motion). Canonicalization, NOT a
correctness fix: clause try-order lives in PatternDispatchPlan
(first-match-wins encoded at plan construction); clause_ids is a
body_id->position lookup kept in lockstep with the pruned clause vector by
construction. Behavior byte-identical 12/12 (interp + AOT, three lens
fixtures, verified at build time).

LANDING EVIDENCE (at 2f3605e28 base): canon movement take_drop 106 lines /
predicate 344 / range_map 0 -- PROVEN PURE PERMUTATION: normalized
multisets of removed/added lines identical after erasing value ids, entry
ids, clause_ids arrays, and clause indices; zero layout/carrier/flow
content lines; tail/continue flows 0/0. (At the PRE-kdt.93 base the same
patch moved return LAYOUTS -- that was fz-kdt.93's lottery, now fixed;
the pure-permutation result here is also fz-kdt.93's regression proof.)
Two red tests landed: entry_reachability_names_clauses_in_source_order_
not_arrival_order and artifact_clause_ids_follow_source_order_on_the_
target_fixtures. One ratchet re-pin with cause: predicate zero-change
4 -> 5 (a spuriously "changed" EntryReachability -- same clause set, new
arrival order -- is now published unchanged; evaluations flat, one fewer
downstream wake). Fresh gate: lib 1513/0, cli 23/0, matrix 425/0, clippy
-D warnings, fmt clean; inventory pins 59/221/214 hold.
